title: Cross-Protocol Liquidation Cascade Detection and Mitigation
narrative: Three risk monitoring agents monitor Aave, Compound, and Curve protocols respectively. Agent A (Aave monitor) detects an abnormal liquidation cascade where 15+ positions are being liquidated within a 10-minute window on Aave V3 Ethereum. The signal must be propagated through the shared knowledge graph to Agents B and C so they can verify whether their monitored protocols are also affected and take coordinated protective action before the cascade spreads.

agents.mission: Detect and alert on abnormal liquidation activity on Aave within 5 minutes of pattern emergence
Verify propagation of liquidation events from other protocols and assess impact on Compound markets in real-time
Monitor Curve pool stability and detect depeg risks triggered by cross-protocol liquidation cascades

trigger_event.description: Abnormal liquidation cascade on Aave V3 Ethereum: 17 positions totaling $1.2M liquidated in 8 minutes at block range 19920000-19920040. Most liquidations involve ETH-collateralized USDC debt positions. ETH price dropped 3% ($2,850 → $2,764) in the same 8-minute window.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: Aave V3 LiquidationCall events 0xdef1a2b3... through 0xdef1a2b3+39 in blocks 19920000-19920040 at 2026-05-30T14:22:00Z

expected_coordination_flow.action: Detect abnormal liquidation pattern: 17 LiquidationCall events in 8 minutes (threshold: 10 events in 10 minutes) → identify pattern as cascade (not isolated liquidations)
Pull alert from shared KG → query Compound liquidation event logs in same block range → detect 3 additional liquidations on Compound totaling $180,000

data_shared.correlation: Same ETH price drop trigger — cascade is cross-protocol

expected_coordination_flow.action: Receive alert from KG → check Curve 3pool (DAI/USDC/USDT) and stETH/ETH pool balance → detect 3pool imbalance at 4.5% deviation (approaching 5% warning threshold)
Aggregate all 3 signals from shared KG → assess systemic risk level: cross-protocol liquidation cascade confirmed across lending markets with spillover to DEX pools
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Systemic risk threshold breached. Recommend: pause new ETH borrowing on Aave and Compound, increase oracle price freshness window

expected_coordination_flow.action: Verify recommendation against Compound risk parameters → simulate utilization rate impact if cascade continues → compound utilization spiked 8% in 20 minutes
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Agree with recommendation — Compound utilization spike supports borrowing pause action

expected_coordination_flow.action: Assess Curve pool trajectory: if cascade continues for another 30 min, 3pool may deviate >5% triggering depeg risk → recommend Curve pool rebalancing incentive increase as preventive measure
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Agree with pause recommendation — add Curve pool preventive rebalancing as secondary action

expected_coordination_flow.action: Execute coordinated response: trigger Aave guardian multisig to pause ETH borrowing → notify risk_b and risk_c via KG of action taken and status

coordination_efficiency.description: Steps from first detection to coordinated response execution across 3 risk monitors

consensus_latency.description: Time from initial detection of cascade to all 3 agents agreeing on coordinated response

communication_overhead.description: Total messages exchanged between 3 risk agents to propagate and confirm signals

system_resilience.description: What happens if risk_a misclassifies a normal liquidation pattern as a cascade (false positive)

scale.1: All agents act on false alarm immediately — unnecessary borrowing pause causes market disruption and reputation damage
scale.3: Some agents question signal quality but follow anyway — partial disruption with delayed recovery
scale.5: Cross-verification by risk_b and risk_c catches the anomaly before action is taken — consensus mechanism rejects false positive within 15 minutes
